behaviour: A firm, deep red pork sausage, coloured and flavoured with paprika and garlic, cured and sold ready to slice or to cook. Sliced and fried, it gives up its red, paprika-scented fat. Simmered whole in a stew, it flavours the broth. The sweet kind is mild and the picante kind is hot.

contains.basis: It is a sausage of pork.
It is a sausage of pork.
Cured sausages are often kept with sulphites.
Some sausages are made with milk protein.
Some sausages are made with a cereal filler.
